{"reason":"Add the supplied high-confidence gate to the existing conditions. V1 makes 20 false arbitrations among 28 decisions (71.4%) while recall is 1.0; six of eight listed false positives have confidence below 0.7 and would be suppressed, sharply lowering false-arbitration rate while preserving the 0.8 recall requirement.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
